mechanism: Eslicarbazepine may increase metformin metabolism and renal clearance through enzyme induction, potentially reducing metformin efficacy, while metformin may increase eslicarbazepine levels through competition for renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor blood glucose control and eslicarbazepine levels; adjust metformin dosing if glycemic control deteriorates; consider alternative antiepileptic if interaction becomes problematic.
